== Japanese printing source review ==
Original Japanese title, lore, game text, subtype, destiny, title marks and icons were read from [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Dark-Collaboration-PSA-20261106.jpg|the original photograph]]. Rarity is from the Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2 Japanese checklist, p.97. English reading aids were prepared by ChatGPT against this photograph and [[:File:Premiere-D-darkcollaboration.gif|the English printed face]]. The Japanese explicitly numbers the two choices. Both faces add two battle destiny when Tarkin is in battle with Tagge or Motti, or cancel Restricted Deployment or Rebel Barrier. The Japanese lore calls the joint operation chilling; the English calls the three leaders a deadly combination. No Credits field is printed.
